reviews.text: Panorama Pet Hospital is a place that you can depend on. They truly care for your pet. Very friendly, accommodating staff with professional Dr’s who tend to your pets needs. My dogs don’t run from that front door when they enter it as they have others in the past. They’re even relaxed in the waiting room. Dr Gupta is our vet. She’s extremely smart and very thorough in her analysis. She’s patient, listens and answers all questions that we may have. I highly recommend this place. We are extremely happy and it’s definitely worth our 20 minute drive.

Very honest establishment.
They are very transparent and forthcoming.
They fixed my dogs ear infection up quickly, with their in-house testing.
Thank you guys so much they have a great team

Very nice and attentive staff!
Easy to speak with.
Great at explaining

I am not going back there, they sold me bunch of medication supposedly my dog need them one of medication cost me more than 300 hundred for deworming, the package was open instead of 6 tablets there were only 3, keep in mined I have been charged for six, since the packaging was open instead did not trust to give it to my dog wanted a refund they refused

I can’t thank Panorama Pet Hospital enough for their incredible care. Even though they were fully booked and had no open appointments, they squeezed us in, got us seen quickly, and never pressure-sold unnecessary services. They recommended only the essential tests needed to diagnose my pet, and their thoughtful follow-up call afterward really showed how much they truly care about their patients.

Everyone there (from the doctor, to the vet techs, volunteers, and staff) are friendly, caring, and knowledgeable, consistently providing excellent, compassionate care to our "furry babies". Highly recommend them, without any hesitation whatsoever. Kudos to all of them!

Panorama Pet Hospital is not your normal, sterile, veterinary office.  It is warm and friendly.  Dr Gupta is just the best!!  She is friendly, knowledgeable and listens to our concerns.  She talks with us, not at us.  Her staff is also super friendly and I don't get anxiety when my dog is led away to the back of the clinic, (which is a rarity anyway as in most cases we are included in the examination).  Definitely a great veterinary hospital!

Dr. Gupta and her team are amazing!
I’m so grateful for the care they have given my pet. Dr. Gupta is incredibly compassionate, patient, and thorough, and you can genuinely tell that she loves what she does.
What really stood out to me was how much time and attention she gave my pet. She never made me feel rushed and took the time to really evaluate everything, listen to my concerns, and make thoughtful decisions about her care. I always felt like my pet was in very good hands.
My pet is doing so much better, and I’m extremely thankful to Dr. Gupta and her team for their dedication and care. It’s comforting to have a veterinarian who not only has the knowledge and experience, but also genuinely cares about her patients and the people who love them.

I highly recommend Dr. Gupta and her team 🐾
My two dogs were seen in a very professional way. Doctor is excellent and staff too
Thank you for the 5-star rating, Karen! We're glad you had a positive experience with us. We look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon!
Thanks for the fantastic rating, Gina! We're happy to know you enjoyed your time with us. We can't wait to see you and your pet again!

Went for the regular allergies shot and medication I've had for my dog. It's always the same, and hasn't changed. We told the lady we would not like a check up and just wanted the medication. Sure enough, we were charged for a check up as well. What was the checkup? An ear check and weight check. Almost $80 for just that. I loved this place, we have been going here for around 2 years, but it's time to move to somewhere else. 😔

Surprisingly nice pet clinic in Panorama City; you would not expect this in this city. I arrived for a 9:30AM appointment and it was empty, very clean, and air conditioned. They gave my dog a lavender handkerchief to help with his nerves. The vet was kind and understanding of our issues. The vet assistant called the next day to ask about how my pet was doing. Easy to schedule appointments online. The exam fee was a little higher than other low-cost clinics, but the care warrants it.
Very friendly and caring vet and technicians.
Very professional, very clean, polite and nice place, …

Edit:
Dr. Sumon sold and left the practice. The new group care more about taking your money than treating your animals. AVOID THIS BUSINESS. I now go to Dr. Oh at Van Nuys Veterinary and he is honest and caring.

Dr. Gupta is amazing! With a thoughtful and attentive approach we are so happy all our  pups (including a few seniors)  are under her care. She is kind, warm and patient and her staff is also very sweet. You can tell everyone really cares and it shows.
DR Gupta and her team were wonderful caring people, thank you for being understanding and taking care of our dog 🐕 like it was your own pet .

Great place to take your animal for a simple check up or an emergency.
Great staff and great veterinarians!
I highly recommend
Randy, thank you so much for taking the time to leave us this amazing review!

Friendly staff. Reasonably priced. Answered all questions and concerns. Provided links for information to take care of little kittens. I will continue to bring my pets here and refer new customers. Very satisfied.

Highly recommend this clinic! Brought my cat Milky in yesterday with signs of feline hyperesthesia, and the medical team was wonderful. They were very thorough and professional. Even though they initially presented comprehensive diagnostic packages to be safe, they fully respected my budget and decisions without making me feel guilty

Milky is already resting comfortably and his spasms have quieted down. Thank you for the compassionate care and for helping my boy feel better!

I can’t say enough wonderful things about Panorama Pet Hospital. My two-year-old border collie, Oreo, had to undergo eye removal surgery, and the care he received was truly exceptional.

Dr. Gupta and her entire staff treated Oreo with so much dignity, respect, and genuine love. During such a difficult time, they made us feel supported every step of the way.

I am beyond grateful for the compassion and expertise they showed. Thank you, Dr. Gupta, for helping Oreo feel better and for taking such incredible care of him. You are truly amazing. 💙

Everyone was incredibly friendly and welcoming. The office and exam room were spacious and clean. I also appreciated that the vet provided recommendations for other clinics that provide low cost services. I definitely plan on bringing my babies here again.
Great place to bring our dog. We know she's in good hands here
The staff have been so kind and respectful toward us and our situation. My dog was taken care of nicely and in good hands with people who truly care about their work.

Thank you, Jackey, for your fantastic 5-star rating! We truly value your support and are thrilled to hear about your positive experience. We're committed to continually striving for excellence and reaching new heights!

The hefty late fee that I wasn't charged wasn't clearly delineated to me as the fees were broken down in the room. I was disappointed that Dr. Gupta didn't meet me at the end of the visit. She was busy eating lunch.

Always a pleasure to go here as I feel I get good quality care.  The doctor is patient and knowledgeable, the staff is one of a kind.  I have been going here for almost 50 years and will continue to go here.  I trust the doctor has my dog's health as their top priority.
Thank you, Mahogany, for your fantastic 5-star rating! We’re excited to hear that your experience with us was a success!
Very friendly and patient. Treating my dog with care.

The nurse and the doctor we're both very kind to both of my cats
I appreciate the time they spent and when they gave them shots. The cats did not even cry. A little bit, they were very gentle. I would definitely recommend them

It's a small place, only 4 parking spaces, better back in for an easy exit. The doctor was nice and so was the staff. It's fairly priced and the treatment offered was reasonable (antibiotics, fever reducer, etc).
There was a lot of trash outside, but I think that's just most of Los Angeles now.
Appointment recommended, fill all the info before the first appointment, nothing too complicated. The person at the reception sprayed calming spray on a fabric an placed it over my cat carrier, which was a nice detail.

Thank you, Amanda, for your wonderful 5-star rating! We’re delighted to hear that you had a positive experience with us. Your support truly inspires us to keep moving forward and striving for excellence.

My family always takes our dogs there! We love the staff and Dr. Rashi is always very caring and informative! She is very knowledgeable and really trustworthy when it comes to caring for our pets. We will always go there!

Dr. Rashi Gupta is truly an exceptional veterinarian. She took incredible care of my dog, Nevi, and treated her with so much compassion, patience, and respect. From the very beginning, Dr. Gupta took the time to explain everything thoroughly, answered all of my questions, and made sure I felt supported during a very emotional and difficult time.

Her kindness, professionalism, and genuine love for animals were evident in every interaction. Nevi was never just a patient — she was treated like family. I am endlessly grateful for the care and empathy Dr. Gupta showed us, and I would trust her with any pet without hesitation.

If you’re looking for a vet who is knowledgeable, attentive, and truly cares, Dr. Rashi Gupta is the absolute best.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ / A Truly Exceptional Veterinary Experience

We recently brought our new puppy to this pet hospital, and from the moment we walked through the door, we knew we had found something special. It’s rare these days to encounter a place where every single person you interact with radiates kindness, professionalism, and genuine care—but that’s exactly what this vet’s office delivers.

From the front desk to the technicians in the back, the entire staff is warm, welcoming, and incredibly patient. They treated our puppy like a member of their own family, speaking to him gently, reassuring him during his exam, and taking the time to answer every one of our new-puppy questions without ever making us feel rushed. Their positive energy and compassion are truly unmatched, and it made what could have been a stressful first visit feel smooth, easy, and even enjoyable.

And then there’s the veterinarian, Dr. Gupta, — an absolute standout. You can tell instantly how knowledgeable and skilled she is, but what really sets her apart is her passion. She doesn’t just love animals; she cares deeply about making sure every patient receives the best possible treatment. She was incredibly thorough in examining our puppy, explaining each step of the process, and giving us clear guidance for his care going forward. Her friendly personality put us at ease immediately, and her dedication to her work is evident in every detail—no question was too small, and no concern was brushed aside.

It’s rare to find a vet who balances expertise with such an authentic, heartfelt approach. We left the appointment feeling confident, informed, and extremely grateful to have found a team that we trust so completely with our puppy’s health and well-being.

If you’re looking for a veterinary facility that goes above and beyond in every possible way—one where the staff treats you like family and the veterinarian provides top-tier care with compassion and enthusiasm—look no further. We are beyond impressed and excited to continue bringing our puppy here for many years to come. This place deserves every bit of praise it gets.
Thank you for your feedback, Larry. We truly value your input and are committed to enhancing your experience with us in the future.
Dr. Gupta and the team are great. They take you in right away. Always very helpful. Ana and Tammy at the front desk are so nice.

A great place! Staff was friendly and service was quick! The receptionist was friendly and all the nurses and doctors were fantastic. 🤩

Dr. Lew was amazing. Great service from Technician Stacy. 10/10 service
